_provenance.upstream_operation: sigGen (deterministic external/preHash groups: pre-hash function coverage)
_provenance.local_operation: deterministic HashML-DSA SigGen via PKCS#11: C_CreateObject(CKA_VALUE = upstream sk) then C_SignInit(CKM_HASH_ML_DSA_<hash>) with CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT hedgeVariant = CKH_DETERMINISTIC_REQUIRED + upstream context, C_Sign; output byte-compared to the upstream signature
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file; same upstream file (and sha256) as mldsa_siggen_det_test.json
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic. Deterministic external/preHash groups. One case for each hashAlg that has a PKCS#11 v3.2 CKM_HASH_ML_DSA_<hash> mechanism and is not already carried by mldsa_siggen_det_test.json (SHA2-224, SHA2-384, SHA2-512 are), assigned to parameter sets in rotation (hash i -> ML-DSA-44/65/87 by i mod 3, falling through to the next set if that group has no case for the hash), each the shortest message for that hash in the group, ties by lowest tcId.
_provenance.retained_fields: tcId, hashAlg, sk, message, context, signature (pk and deferred dropped)
_provenance.test_only_key_material: sk values are public NIST ACVP-Server sample data, imported into a session (CKA_TOKEN=false) object and destroyed after the case; they are not secrets
